given: A run crashed; its own error line names the failing call.
expect: Use that error line as the root cause and name a unittest id as the recurrence test.
why: The root cause comes from the evidence, and the same crash keeps the same key.

given: The post-mortem names an old passing test that never touched the failure as its recurrence test.
expect: Name a new unittest id on the fix card that fails before the fix.
why: A borrowed passing test cannot catch a repeat.
